_comment: Curated descriptions for well-known player-data keys. Purely cosmetic: they become the comment
above the key in the generated worldswitcher-playerdata.toml and show up in
/wsc config playerdata scan. Anything not listed here falls back to the owning mod's display
name plus a guess derived from the shape of the stored NBT.
'mod' is only needed for persistent-NBT keys, which carry no namespace to look up.

curios:inventory.what: All Curios accessory slots — rings, charms, belts, and whatever other mods add to them (Elytra Slot, Caelus, a worn tool belt, ...)

carryon:carry_on_data.what: The block or entity the player is currently carrying on their head

cosmeticarmorreworked:cosarmor.what: Cosmetic armor slots and their hide-vanilla-armor flags

WaystonesData.what: Which waystones the player has activated

PlayerPersisted.what: Generic 'survives death' sub-tag — several mods put their own data in here
